retargeted_glb.input: CC0 GLB asset, named animation, 30 FPS and phase annotations
retargeted_glb.output: 64 mapped Beta bones with world/rest-basis rotations, pelvis residual and separate root motion; mirroring respects destination bone bases

hybrid.input: full-body source poses, calibrated phase windows and world goals
hybrid.output: FK body/shoulder/elbow/hip motion, gradual arm aim and limited contact correction; support targets follow source feet and fix planted feet

procedural.input: guard pose, phase, direction, intensity and targets
procedural.output: full-body control for uppercut, block, dodge, pursuit, impact impulse and persistent recoil step

fall_reaction.input: final knockdown contact, retargeted Death01, ground plane
fall_reaction.output: full-body falling poses with standing IK released, ground correction and final pose held; no get-up or ground combat

standing_recoil.input: compatible head/body reaction, reversed Walk lower-body poses, matched source-root phase and requested retreat distance
standing_recoil.output: body reaction synchronized to contact, backward stepping and persistent final position; Hit_Knockback ends lying down and is unsuitable for standing stagger

external_model.contract: Must output Beta-compatible local poses, source FPS, contact/stance phases; validate before registration
